details.completeness_justification: All HIGH items (K1-K5) are fully represented. K6 is only partially covered because the candidate reports a different operating-cash-flow figure (EUR 1.625 m vs. the required EUR 2.41 m). K8 and K9 are only partially covered because the candidate omits the required percentage shares and the explicit year-over-year comparison for dry-milk products. The overall picture of improved profitability and liquidity is captured.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence follows logically from the preceding ones: revenue stability and segment/product breakdowns (S2–S4) lead directly to the cost-of-sales reduction (S5) that explains the gross-profit and margin improvement (S6). Operating-profit growth (S9) is explicitly linked to the offsetting effects of higher other income (S7) and increased expenses (S8). Net-profit and EPS figures (S11–S12) are consistent with the stated pre-tax profit and zero tax (S13). Cash-flow statements (S15–S19) logically connect to the ending cash balance (S20), and balance-sheet movements (S21–S22) are presented as direct consequences of the reported profit and cash changes. No self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational disarray, or unnecessary repetitions are present.
